answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 460 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the garden here is verification, the cedar of cost is what stops the farm, and the prism of the record keeps every claim checkable.
